## Load vaccination data from epic cosmos

```{r}
vax_raw <- read_csv("data/vax-ct-georgia.csv")
abcs_counties <- readxl::read_xlsx("data/ABCsCountyFIPS.xlsx") |> 
  filter(STATE %in% c("CT", "MD", "NY", "CA", "NM", "TN"))
```

## Geocode by zipcode

```{r}
zips_in_data <- unique(vax_raw$geography)

zctas_sf <- tigris::zctas(year = 2020, cb = TRUE) |>
  filter(ZCTA5CE20 %in% zips_in_data) |>
  dplyr::select(geography = ZCTA5CE20, geometry) |>
  st_transform(4326)

states_sf <- tigris::states(cb = TRUE, year = 2020) |>
  dplyr::select(state_name = NAME, geometry) |>
  st_transform(4326)

zcta_centroids <- zctas_sf |>
  st_centroid() |>
  st_join(states_sf, join = st_within) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  dplyr::select(geography, state_name)

zctas_sf <- zctas_sf |>
  left_join(zcta_centroids, by = "geography")

map_data <- zctas_sf |>
  left_join(vax_raw, by = "geography")
```

## Get census tracts

```{r}
census_tracts <- tigris::tracts(state = "CT", year = "2010") |> 
  st_transform(4326) |> 
  dplyr::select(GEOID10, geometry)
```

## Intersect zipcodes with census tracts (CT)

```{r}
ct_zipcode <- map_data |> 
  filter(state_name == "Connecticut" & age == "≥ 2 and < 5 Years") |> 
  filter(!is.na(pct_pcv))

zcta_tract_intersection <- st_intersection(census_tracts, ct_zipcode)
```

```{r}
zcta_tract_intersection_areas <- zcta_tract_intersection |>
  st_make_valid() |> 
  mutate(intersect_area = st_area(geometry)) |>
  group_by(GEOID10) |>
  mutate(tract_area = sum(intersect_area),
         weight = as.numeric(intersect_area / tract_area)) |>
  ungroup()

tract_vax <- zcta_tract_intersection_areas |>
  st_drop_geometry() |> 
  group_by(GEOID10) |>
  summarise(pct_pcv_weighted = sum(pct_pcv * weight, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

census_tracts_vax <- census_tracts |>
  left_join(tract_vax, by = "GEOID10")

# write_rds(census_tracts_vax, "data/connecticut-vax-census-tract.rds")
```

```{r}
ct_zipcode |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = pct_pcv)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "H", limits = c(0, 100)) +
  theme_bw()

census_tracts_vax |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = pct_pcv_weighted)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "H", limits = c(0, 100)) +
  theme_bw()
```

## Intersect census tracts with zipcodes

```{r}
tract_zipcode_intersection <- st_intersection(ct_zipcode, census_tracts)

tract_zipcode_intersection_areas <- tract_zipcode_intersection |> 
  st_make_valid() |> 
  mutate(intersect_area = st_area(geometry)) |>
  group_by(geography) |>
  mutate(zipcode_area = sum(intersect_area),
         weight = as.numeric(intersect_area / zipcode_area)) |>
  ungroup()
```

## Intersect zipcodes with census tracts (GA)

```{r}
ga_zipcode <- map_data |> 
  filter(state_name == "Georgia" & age == "≥ 2 and < 5 Years") |> 
  filter(!is.na(pct_pcv))

census_tracts_ga <- tigris::tracts(state = "GA", year = "2010") |> 
  st_transform(4326) |> 
  dplyr::select(GEOID10, geometry)

zcta_tract_intersection_ga <- st_intersection(census_tracts_ga, ga_zipcode)
```

```{r}
zcta_tract_intersection_ga_areas <- zcta_tract_intersection_ga |>
  st_make_valid() |> 
  mutate(intersect_area = st_area(geometry)) |>
  group_by(GEOID10) |>
  mutate(tract_area = sum(intersect_area),
         weight = as.numeric(intersect_area / tract_area)) |>
  ungroup()

tract_vax_ga <- zcta_tract_intersection_ga_areas |>
  st_drop_geometry() |> 
  group_by(GEOID10) |>
  summarise(pct_pcv_weighted = sum(pct_pcv * weight, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

census_tracts_vax_ga <- census_tracts_ga |>
  left_join(tract_vax_ga, by = "GEOID10")

# write_rds(census_tracts_vax_ga, "data/georgia-vax-census-tract.rds")
```

## Get age-stratified population

(dictionary pulled from https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/acs/technical-documentation/table-shells.2021.html#list-tab-79594641)

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidycensus)
var_dict_raw <- read_csv("data/act-variables.csv")

var_dict <- var_dict_raw |> 
  filter(age_group == "Under 5 years")
```

### 1-yr acs

```{r}
# # change:
# census_api_key("KEY", install = TRUE)

age_data_list <- list()

for (year in 2006:2019) {
  age_data_list[[as.character(year)]] <- get_acs(
    geography = "county",
    state = c("CT", "MD", "NY", "CA", "NM", "TN"),
    table = "B01001",
    year = year,
    survey = "acs1",
    output = "tidy",
    cache_table = TRUE
  )
}

for (year in 2021:2023) {
  age_data_list[[as.character(year)]] <- get_acs(
    geography = "county",
    state = c("CT", "MD", "NY", "CA", "NM", "TN"),
    table = "B01001",
    year = year,
    survey = "acs1",
    output = "tidy",
    cache_table = TRUE
  )
}

age_data_all <- bind_rows(age_data_list, .id = "year") |> 
  filter(variable %in% var_dict$var) |> 
  group_by(year, GEOID, NAME) |> 
  summarise(pop_under5 = sum(estimate),
            .groups = "drop")

age_data_full <- cross_join(data.frame(year = as.character(c(2006:2024))),
                            data.frame(GEOID = unique(age_data_all$GEOID))) |> 
  left_join(age_data_all, by = c("year", "GEOID")) |> 
  arrange(year) |> 
  group_by(GEOID) |> 
  mutate(pop_under5_complete = zoo::na.approx(pop_under5, rule = 2)) |> 
  filter(!(!year %in% c(2020, 2024) & is.na(NAME)))

# write_rds(age_data_full, "data/county-population-under5.rds")
```

### 5-yr acs

```{r}
age_data_list2 <- list()

for (year in seq(from = 2009, to = 2023, by = 5)) {
  age_data_list2[[as.character(year)]] <- get_acs(
    geography = "county",
    state = c("CT", "MD", "NY", "CA", "NM", "TN"),
    table = "B01001",
    year = year,
    survey = "acs5",
    output = "tidy",
    cache_table = TRUE
  )
}

age_data_all2 <- bind_rows(age_data_list2, .id = "year") |> 
  filter(variable %in% var_dict$var) |> 
  group_by(year, GEOID, NAME) |> 
  summarise(pop_under5 = sum(estimate),
            .groups = "drop")

county_names <- age_data_all2 |> 
  distinct(GEOID, NAME) |> 
  ungroup()

age_data_full2 <- cross_join(data.frame(year = as.character(c(2005:2024))),
                             data.frame(GEOID = unique(age_data_all2$GEOID))) |> 
  left_join(age_data_all2, by = c("year", "GEOID")) |> 
  arrange(year) |> 
  group_by(GEOID) |> 
  mutate(pop_under5_complete = zoo::na.approx(pop_under5, rule = 2)) |> 
  filter(GEOID %in% abcs_counties$FIPS) |> 
  dplyr::select(-NAME)

# write_rds(age_data_full2, "data/county-population-under5-acs5.rds")
```
